scope: Real cold-broker CLI create/no-op acceptance without fixture coordinator warmup; replacement remains blocked

distributions.python_source_tree_digest_format: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping package-relative .py paths to file SHA-256 values
distributions.note: These hashes identify the exact tested archives. Later documentation/evidence-only builds need not reproduce the archive hashes.

sequence: Require complete consumer-group inventory and reject the exact application ID if present.
Describe only the requested application ID; retry only native NOT_COORDINATOR, COORDINATOR_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS and COORDINATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE errors within the remaining deadline.
Accept native GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND or the exact legacy DEAD/CLASSIC, simple=true, empty-members, empty-assignor description of the same ID.
Read stable offsets for the entire exact group; require an exact empty topic-partition list or native GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND.
Recheck complete consumer-group inventory under the same deadline and reject an application group that appeared concurrently.
cold_coordinator_contract.native_diagnostic_observation: A separately owned cold broker first returned NOT_COORDINATOR (16), then a native DEAD/CLASSIC simple group with no members, empty assignor, empty stable offsets and absent inventory. That diagnostic broker was cleaned up.

journey_assertions: The first real online plan on each fresh broker succeeds without fixture-side group describe, group join or offset initialization; __consumer_offsets was absent immediately before that plan.
The internal-topic absence assertion is test-only; product preflight uses bounded Admin reads and never explicitly creates or manages the internal offsets topic.

Existing-topic import preview, import and repeated preview preserve external ownership and enriched declarations; managed SQL processing and the dependent metadata-only custom application share validated lineage.
The fresh path uses the installed/source init --executor kafka_streams starter without changing its intended specification.
Both paths pass strict validation, lineage, dry compilation and offline planning with provider access forbidden.
Missing consumed column and incompatible known consumed type reject plan/apply before provider access or any local file mutation.

Invalid internal bootstrap rejects plan/apply without changing provider topics, UUIDs, configuration, partitions, groups, owned containers/volumes, declarations or .streamt state/control/private files.
Rejected runtime apply may regenerate generated/ local compilation artifacts; this is not classified as provider or state mutation.

Actual apply starts an owned runner0.1.1 with verified cluster/input/output identities; five inputs yield exactly one read_committed JSON output id=a, amount=120, preserving raw key00ff and reaching committed input offset5.
A second online plan is unchanged and a second actual apply preserves the same container and committed progress.
External input topic identity/configuration remain unchanged; genuine removed topic overrides reconcile with DELETE while inherited broker settings stay untouched.

cleanup_per_run.scope: Only exact generated identities with verified ownership labels

limits: The consumer-group API coverage is CLASSIC/CONSUMER. These checks do not establish universal absence of Share, Connect or other group types sharing the Kafka group-ID namespace.
Only the first existing-topic path on each broker starts with a cold coordinator; the subsequent fresh-topology path uses that now-ready broker.
Kafka may internally initialize its coordinator metadata in response to read-only Admin requests. Streamt sends no explicit internal-topic creation or offset mutation during the readiness preflight.

ExitCode143 is the actual runner0.1.1 JVM response to TERM in all four cases. This is not a failed create/no-op journey, but it does not satisfy a replacement contract requiring ExitCode0. No replacement execution is enabled or accepted here.
Cleanup records process termination only; it does not prove the fresh closed-status and inactive-group conditions needed for a future replacement contract.
No restart, replacement, rollback, checkpoint recovery, retention-loss recovery or exactly-once recovery guarantee is established.
Custom applications remain metadata-only declarations; the test supplies its own consumer rather than product scheduling.
Real coverage uses one local plaintext broker and one partition per topic on Darwin arm64/Python3.12. It does not establish live SASL/TLS, remote Docker, multi-broker or multi-partition support.
Raw logs, host endpoints, credentials and temporary paths are not included in this curated record.
